visualReview.notes: All ten portable and ten shared current frames inspected. Narrow port surrounds now expose the recessed glazing at oblique views. Eight concrete ribs, three circular braces, entry stairs, sixteen service ports, flared support head, paired galleries, scalloped brackets, diamond lantern bars, optic and white dome are connected and correctly wound.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared red plaster, painted iron and granite materials preserve meter scale. Small dark panes are now visible and the transparent lantern retains its fine frame. Material sharing and unload assertions passed.

geographicReview.notes: Authority ATON coordinate centers the tower. Native doorway southeast quadrant follows the society aerial and station approach, with eight-rib 45-degree mass symmetry. This is photograph-guided direction, not a surveyed facade azimuth. Ground-contact placement and centered north-up footprint were inspected.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Authority total height and service-drum diameter plus the archived 1925 elevation/section control the reconstructed concrete-jacketed form. Current authority photos confirm the maintained red/white exterior. Minor vent, railing and molding dimensions follow the visible references; detached station buildings remain map context. No scan-level finish claim.
